findings: Reviewed the v7.4.0 bilingual README delta against the current diagnostic viewer and scenario review code. Recoverable review warnings retain evidence without triggering the terminal-error viewer; final review outcomes are separately recorded. Full exports remain complete while preview is capped and loading feedback is shown. Native page emotion interpretation now shares the existing four-panel normalizer, retaining authored acting. Absent emotion tags retain reference fallback. Action direction now rejects a large preparation pose followed only by tiny manipulation, while preserving news facts and explicit constraints. Reported clipping permits content recomposition within fixed panel bounds. Empty or partial valid local frame detection uses the existing single whole-page assessment, requiring observed geometry and keeping uncertainty unverified. The selected models, bounded retry and safety contracts remain unchanged. Luna image QA alone now explicitly uses documented high reasoning effort; ordinary routes retain defaults. The strict schema emits anonymous bodies/text before identity and verdicts, rather than corrections first. Lettering uses observed glyph columns and exact source corrections; tail ownership uses independent geometry. Local raster lettering was withdrawn after the user observed smaller, thinner, sparse text. Normal generation keeps exact API output pixels and the original plus repaired history candidates; only confirmed text defects are sent to the bounded API edit with source typeface, weight, size and density preserved. Edit prompts lead with corrections before the complete approved reference. Source/public tree IDs are the collector-provided committed HEAD trees; this candidate remains uncommitted and per-file evidence is kept in the bugfix work record. Causal speaker references are excluded only at that occurrence; independently visible action/camera/speech remains required. New-script camera geometry and short fact distribution are guided without rewriting existing dialogue. Explicitly passing evidenced unused correction fields are normalized across review items; failures and absent evidence remain invalid, replayed against the actual six-panel API response. Mixed-repair compaction covers lettering, camera and cast with all targets and original prompt retained. No deployment is claimed. The final additional README delta documents lossless multipart image uploads above the JSON URL limit; reviewed against normalizeOpenAIImageUpload and generateOpenAIImageEdit. Files remain below50MB; JSON retains20971520characters, same endpoint/model/quality/size, no recompression or request retry. This source change still needs actual API acceptance. Boundary repair permits page gutter movement only for evidenced boundary mismatches, preserving all cast/content/cameras; ordinary clipping retains its rectangle. Reviewed cast-review README delta against castInventoryIssues, experimentalRepairIssues and buildCastRepairConservation: grounded known out-of-panel bodies get remove_all while required identities are retained. Unknown names, uncertain/reused bindings and unobserved features cannot authorize removal. Actual API acceptance still pending. Frame-proportions change reviewed against observedFrameProportionIssues: measured complete nonoverlapping frames are normalized to their actual comic bounds, excluding outer margins/title/footer; more than0.04 normalized edge movement is material. Ambiguous geometry creates no inferred correction. Full original rect contracts remain in the approved appendix. Compact cast and boundary wording retains the same targets, counts, evidence and preservation conditions.
